Title: Public preview: Azure Search indexer for Azure tables

Body.Content: Azure Search indexers can crawl your Azure table storage. You can set up the Azure Search table indexer to run on a schedule and re-index only new or updated rows. Currently this functionality is in preview. It is available only in the REST API, using version 2015-02-28-Preview. Check out this article to learn more, and let us know what you think!
Body.Markdown:
Azure Search indexers can crawl your Azure table storage. You can set up the Azure Search table indexer to run on a schedule and re-index only new or updated rows.

Check out this article to learn more, and let us know what you think!
